title: Hearty Uruguayan Beef Empanadas
description: Buttery, aerated empanadas flavored with ras el hanout and caramelized vegetables, perfect for a cozy meal.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat and sauté onion and garlic until translucent.
Add carrot, cumin, coriander, and ras el hanout to the pan and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Stir in ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart with a spoon.
Mix in tomato paste and simmer for 7 minutes until the mixture thickens slightly.
Season the filling with salt and pepper, let it cool for 5 minutes, then spoon onto pastry crusts.
Seal the edges with a fork, brush the tops with a beaten egg for shine, and bake for 25 minutes until golden.
Let the empanadas rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
